Key_Symptoms: Sore cracked lips, mouth soreness, burning sensation on tongue, sensitivity to light
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis (cracks at mouth corners), vertical fissuring of lips, magenta-colored tongue
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Sore throat, glossitis, seborrheic dermatitis around nose, eye irritation/light sensitivity
Risk_Factors: Poor dietary intake of dairy/eggs/meat/leafy greens, alcoholism, malabsorption, prolonged restrictive diets

Key_Symptoms: Sore red lips, diarrhea, skin rash on sun-exposed areas, mental confusion
Visible_Lip_Signs: Bright red, swollen, cracked lips, glossitis (beefy red tongue), angular stomatitis
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Classic triad: dermatitis, diarrhea, dementia (pellagra); photosensitive skin rash, fatigue
Risk_Factors: Corn-based diet without niacin fortification, alcoholism, carcinoid syndrome, isoniazid therapy, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Sore cracked lips, irritability, confusion, numbness in extremities
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Peripheral neuropathy, seborrheic dermatitis, microcytic anemia, depression, confusion
Risk_Factors: Alcoholism, certain medications (isoniazid, hydralazine), malabsorption, poor dietary intake, pregnancy

Key_Symptoms: Sore lips and tongue, fatigue, weakness, shortness of breath
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis, glossitis (smooth red tongue), pale or swollen lips
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Megaloblastic anemia symptoms: fatigue, pallor, irritability, poor concentration
Risk_Factors: Poor dietary intake of leafy greens/legumes, alcoholism, pregnancy, malabsorption, certain medications (methotrexate)

Key_Symptoms: Sore lips and tongue, numbness/tingling, fatigue, memory problems
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis, glossitis (beefy red/smooth tongue), pale lips
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Megaloblastic anemia, peripheral neuropathy, memory issues, pale skin, glossitis
Risk_Factors: Vegan/vegetarian diet, pernicious anemia, gastric bypass surgery, elderly age, metformin use, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Pale/dry cracked lips, fatigue, brittle nails, cold intolerance
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis, pallor of lips, atrophic glossitis (smooth pale tongue)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, pallor, dizziness, koilonychia (spoon nails), restless legs, hair thinning
Risk_Factors: Heavy menstrual bleeding, poor dietary iron intake, pregnancy, chronic blood loss, GI disorders

Key_Symptoms: Sore cracked lips, delayed wound healing, altered taste, skin lesions
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis, perioral dermatitis, dry/cracked lip margins
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Acrodermatitis enteropathica-like rash, diarrhea, impaired immunity, poor appetite, hair loss
Risk_Factors: Malabsorption syndromes, vegetarian/vegan diet, chronic diarrhea, alcoholism, pregnancy

Key_Symptoms: Soreness and redness at corners of mouth, white patches inside mouth, burning sensation
Visible_Lip_Signs: Angular cheilitis with white/yellow plaques, erythema and maceration at mouth corners, possible satellite lesions
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Oral thrush (white coating on tongue/palate), may coexist with underlying immunosuppression or diabetes
Risk_Factors: Denture wearers, immunosuppression, diabetes, antibiotic use, excessive lip licking, moist environment at mouth corners

Key_Symptoms: Itching, swelling, redness of lips, burning sensation after exposure to allergen
Visible_Lip_Signs: Swollen, red, sometimes vesicular or scaly lips, sharply demarcated area matching contact exposure
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Possible associated allergic contact dermatitis elsewhere on face
Risk_Factors: Lipstick/lip balm ingredients, toothpaste, dental materials, certain foods, fragrances, preservatives

Key_Symptoms: Dryness, cracking, burning sensation, lip tightness
Visible_Lip_Signs: Dry, scaly, cracked lips without sharp demarcation, chapping
Risk_Factors: Lip licking habit, cold/dry weather, frequent mouth breathing, harsh lip products, excessive sun/wind exposure

Key_Symptoms: Persistent dryness, scaling, rough texture on lower lip, occasional ulceration
Visible_Lip_Signs: Whitish/rough patches on lower lip, loss of normal lip border definition (vermilion border blurring), possible ulceration
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Generally localized to lips; history of significant cumulative sun exposure
Risk_Factors: Chronic sun exposure, fair skin, outdoor occupation, older age, smoking

Key_Symptoms: Chronic dry, itchy, scaly lips, recurrent cracking
Visible_Lip_Signs: Dry, scaly, lichenified lips with possible fissuring, perioral dryness
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: History of atopic dermatitis, asthma, allergic rhinitis (atopic triad)
Risk_Factors: Personal/family history of atopic dermatitis, asthma, allergies, dry climate

Key_Symptoms: Persistent peeling/scaling of lips, burning sensation, cosmetic concern from visible scaling
Visible_Lip_Signs: Continuous shedding/peeling of superficial lip skin layers, crusting, thickened scale buildup
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Often associated with anxiety or habitual lip picking/biting; occasionally psychological component
Risk_Factors: Habitual lip picking/biting, chronic irritation, psychological/stress factors, idiopathic in many cases

Visible_Lip_Signs: Smooth, moist, evenly pigmented lips with intact vermilion border, no cracking or lesions
